apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- If reading a schedule fails, the message now says why (for example, the
  service isn't set up or Claude is busy), instead of a general error

- Import schedule from a photo: on a season's Events tab, take a photo or
  screenshot of a schedule (or pick a PDF). Claude reads the games, you check
  and fix them, and they're added as upcoming games for your ★ player(s).
  Dates that already have a game are skipped by default
- Games can have a kickoff time, home/away, and location (set on import or in
  the match form), shown on upcoming games

- Players now live entirely under each season's team: the Players tab is
  gone from the bottom bar
- Season pages have three tabs: Events (start/log matches, upcoming games
  and results), Team (the roster) and Stats (totals and chart)
- On the Team tab, tap a player's name to edit them (name, position, ★, and
  this team's photo and number), and pick their position when adding them
- Taking a teammate off their only team deletes them; your ★ players are
  always kept
- Importing a list always goes into a team
- Duplicate a team for another season (Team tab, or the season's ⋮ menu):
  pick the season and optionally rename the team; the roster, numbers and
  photos carry over, games and stats don't

- Each season page has a Roster: add a player, add someone already on your
  list, or import a list — straight onto that team. Tap a photo or number to
  change it for that team only; tap ✕ to take someone off the team
- Team photos: a player can have a different photo for each team (tap their
  photo, or Edit them, under that team on the Players tab or on the season
  roster). Shown on that team's roster and in live scoring
- On the Players tab, Edit under a team changes that team's photo and
  number; Edit under My players changes the usual ones
- ★ marks your own player(s). Only they get Start match buttons, stats,
  match logging and match imports; teammates are on rosters for names and
  numbers. Existing players stay tracked, and teammates brought in by the
  1.3.0 team import are recognized as teammates
- Players tab groups everyone under My players, then each season/team they're
  on (newest first), then anyone not on a team
- New season: pick your own player(s); add teammates from the season page
- Seasons list shows your player(s) and the team size instead of every name

- Photos for players and seasons/teams: choose one from your phone (or take
  one) or paste a link, then drag and zoom to crop it
- Photos show on the Players and Seasons lists, the season page, and the
  live scoring screen
- Jersey numbers: a usual number per player, plus a different number per
  season/team where needed (set in the season's Edit). Shown on the Players
  list, the season page, and live scoring
- Import a team: paste a list of names and numbers (or copy them from a
  spreadsheet) from Players → Import team or a season's menu → Import
  players. Existing players aren't duplicated; numbers imported into a
  season are saved for that team
